items.quote: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.
items.contrast: Micah’s house versus the young man’s own house.
items.reason: The surrounding lines say that the Levite agreed to live with Micah, became like Micah’s son, and became Micah’s priest. Thus “his house” refers to Micah’s house. The question clearly tests resolution of that possessive reference rather than mere fact retrieval.
